purpose: Define a fresh, species-disjoint and higher-taxon-disjoint confirmatory dataset for the biological claim that geographic location can predict mitochondrial intraspecific differentiation in unseen species. The Decker panel remains development/pilot only.

source.required_download_time: after this protocol freeze and before any confirmatory sequence identity is inspected
required_per_species_files: aligned FASTA for the selected COI-family locus
occurrence file linking accessions to latitude/longitude
source.provenance_freeze: Archive the complete genes.txt and cite.txt plus cryptographic hashes of every selected FASTA and occurrence file before confirmatory synthetic qualification.

taxonomic_universe.rationale: The confirmatory test must not be a second sample of the bird/bat development panel and should challenge transfer across a materially broader lineage set.

marker_contract.alias_normalization: uppercase, trim whitespace, replace underscore and hyphen with a single space before exact alias matching
marker_contract.multiple_candidate_alignments_per_specie: choose the candidate with the largest number of unique provided geographic localities among aligned FASTA accessions; break ties by larger aligned sequence count, then lexicographically by raw locus/file identifier

phase_1_response_blind_geometry.sequence_information_allowed: FASTA accession/header membership only; nucleotide characters are not opened
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.locality: exact latitude-longitude values supplied in the phylogatR occurrence file; do not introduce additional coordinate rounding beyond the downloaded database values
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.graph_rule: same density-scaled undirected kNN graph used by qualified genetic TTF
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.selection_if_more_than_250_species: rank eligible species by SHA256 of the UTF-8 string '<phylogatR cite.txt digest>|<canonical species name>' and retain the first 250; this is independent of genetic sequence identity, genetic distance, range, class, and transfer support
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.panel_size_rule: use all eligible species when 150-250; if fewer than 150 the confirmatory arm is NOT_EVALUABLE; never lower the threshold after seeing sequence identity
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.split: deterministic species-disjoint 50/50 split from SHA256('<dataset digest>|split|<species>'), taking the lower half as training and upper half as evaluation; no outcome-based rebalancing
phase_1_response_blind_geometry.support_policy: do not drop low-support evaluation species post hoc; dataset-specific synthetic qualification determines whether the frozen geometry is usable

phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.purpose: Check whether frozen edges can be assigned the predeclared p-distance without revealing nucleotide identity or genetic divergence.
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.allowed_view: For every aligned character, reveal only canonical-valid versus noncanonical/missing: A/C/G/T -> 1; gap, N and IUPAC ambiguity -> 0. Do not retain which canonical nucleotide was present.
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.valid_sequence_pair: comparable canonical columns >= ceil(0.5 * frozen alignment length)
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.valid_edge: at least one valid cross-locality sequence pair exists for the two frozen endpoint localities
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.species_admissible: every edge in that species' frozen graph is valid
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.failed_species: mark NOT_EVALUABLE; do not rewire edges or choose another marker
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.post_mask_rule: Freeze the surviving species panel and a new geometry fingerprint, then repeat the full genetic Gate-D synthetic qualification on that exact surviving panel before any A/C/G/T identity is unmasked.
phase_2_character_mask_admissibility.if_below_minimum: confirmatory arm is NOT_EVALUABLE and nucleotide identity remains unopened

phase_3_synthetic_qualification.method: same endpoint-safe rank-IBD residualization, v0.11 geometry control, profiled-private inference, reference configuration family, alpha and Wilson gates as the qualified Decker-development genetic method
phase_3_synthetic_qualification.failure: NOT_EVALUABLE; do not inspect confirmatory pairwise genetic distances

phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance = canonical A/C/G/T mismatches / columns where both sequences are canonical
phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over all valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distances
phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.edge_response: locality-pair distance on the already-frozen graph edge
phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.primary_test: frozen out-of-species profiled-private TTF test on the frozen training/evaluation split
phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.confirmatory_positive: positive held-out T with profiled-private p <= 0.05
phase_4_empirical_response_if_qualified.confirmatory_negative: interpret using the separately qualified within-species detectability gate; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE

confirmatory_claim.positive_Decker_and_positive_phylogatR: evidence for a transferable geography of mitochondrial intraspecific differentiation that replicates outside the bird/bat development clades
confirmatory_claim.positive_Decker_negative_phylogatR_with_: transfer is development-panel or lineage-domain conditioned rather than broadly lineage-transcending
confirmatory_claim.positive_Decker_negative_phylogatR_witho: confirmatory arm NOT_EVALUABLE, not a contradiction
confirmatory_claim.Decker_not_opened_or_negative: phylogatR remains an independently predeclared confirmatory path and must not be redesigned around the Decker empirical outcome

forbidden: using genetic divergence to choose species, locus, split, or geographic support
including any Aves or Chiroptera in the confirmatory panel
choosing a different marker for a species after identity unmasking
deleting individual high-divergence sequences based on the TTF response
changing minimum locality count, panel-size minimum, graph density, bandwidth, alpha, or qualification gates after sequence identity is opened
treating a failed geometry, mask, or power gate as a biological null
